event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 59 degrees, relative humidity 73 percent, barometer 30.17 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,035 feet. 

13 of the 14 Funny Car wins this year have come from the top half of the field.
Austin Prock's win in Budds Creek (#11) is the only Funny Car win this year from the bottom half of
the field.

Daniel Wilkerson is 6-8 in Round 1 this year.
Spencer Hyde has lost in Round 1 at the last three races. His average E.T. in those three losses is
5.456.
This is the only Funny Car Round 1 matchup in which neither driver has won a race.

They leave together and Wilkerson get the win in a close race.  Daniel Wilkerson's MOV: 0.0110
seconds (approximately 5 feet).

Ron Capps' last four losses this year have come against current or former Funny Car World Champions.
He is 36-18 in Round 1 when qualified #7.
In his eight races since his win in Chicago, Chad Green is 4-8.

Capps is 8 - 5 against Green in prior events. 

Green with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Capps launched hard and kept it hooked up and makes his career fastest pass for the win.

Alexis DeJoria is 9-5 in Round 1 this year.
Hunter Green is 2-5 overall this year.

Green with a the starting line advantage and good pass early, then around the half tack the engine
let go with a huge fireball.  the car made a quick move across the track and hit the left wall.  the
car bounced off the wall and then back into it before comming to a stop.  Green is out of the car.

DeJoria is straight down the groove with her quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Cruz Pedregon is 45-13 in Round 1 when qualified #4.
Terry Haddock is making his 171st career start.

Pedregon is 11 - 0 against Haddock in prior events. 

Haddock with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He runs his season quickest
and fastest pass for the win.  He gets real loose on the top end and crosses the centerline in the
shut down area.

Pedregon lost traction early and clicked it off.

Prock and Vandergriff have each won 3 times against the other in prior events. 

Prock goes red to give Vandergriff the win, who is up in smoke right at the hit, but gets the win.
He will give up lane choice to Wilkerson in the next round.

Seven of Jack Beckman's 12 losses this year have come against current or former Funny Car World
Champions.
Jeff Diehl is making his 102nd career start.

Beckman is 7 - 0 against Diehl in prior events. 

Beckman is 7 - 0 against Diehl in prior events. 

Beckman with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes the quickest pass
of the season in Funny Car and his fastest of the season for the win.  He will have lane choice over
Capps in the next round.

Diehl with a good pass early, but lost traction around half track.

Matt Hagan wins 81% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice.
Joey Haas advanced to the final round in his last start in Denver in 2021.

Haas with the starting line advantage, but started to drop cylinders, he pedaled and pulled the front
end.  He pedaled it one more time, but Hagan had the difference made up and took the win.

Hagan with tire shake and pedaled it and got it to hook up enough for the win.  He will give up lane
choice to DeJoria in the next round.

J.R. Todd wins 67% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice.
Dave Richards lost to Todd in Round 1 at Gainesville this year.

Todd is 2 - 0 against Richards in prior events. 

Todd with the starting line advantage for the win.  He will have lane choice over Haddock in the next
round.

Richards shook right at the hit and clicked it off.
